_comment: Representative curved-panel RVE: deep x-grooves that run nearly through a 30 mm core, leaving a 3 mm foam ligament at the bottom (depth = thickness - 3 = 27, top-mouth so depth is negative). For other cores keep the 3 mm floor: 25 mm -> depth -22, 50 mm -> depth -47. A mold curvature kx>0 opens these grooves (more infused resin); kx<0 closes them, pinching at the mouth. Sweep/curve scripts override curvature.kx. PVC foam + epoxy.
